search_text: published ZDI-20-761 ZDI-CAN-9718 (0Day) CentOS Web Panel ajax_php_pecl cha Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2020-06-25 CVE-2020-15614 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-15614 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['CentOS Web Panel'] ['CentOS Web Panel'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of CentOS Web Panel. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within ajax_php_pecl.php. When parsing the cha parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
